referenceFunction.includedProcesses:
Electricity from wind farm, fed to grid. Includes the operation of the wind farm with the necessary change of gear oil. A leackage of 5% of SF6 is assumed over the entire life cycle of the wind farm. The 740 MW wind farm consists of 74 wind turbines with a nominal capacity of 10 MW and monopile substructure, as well as 1 offshore substation and 1 land-based substation. The modelled wind farm represents the IEA Wind 740-10 MW Reference Offshore Wind Plant, derived in the IEA Wind Task 55 (Kainz, Quick, et al., 2024). The distance to service port is 50 km. Total length of export cables is 203 km (consisting of 3 parallel export cables). The total length of array cables is 140 km. The model uses a capacity factor of 34.1%, representing the average capacity factor of offshore wind farms in Europe between 2016-2024 (source: ENTSO-E). Assumed lifetime is 25 years. Annual electricity production is 2212 GWh, applying a capacity factor of 34.1%.
Kainz, S., Quick, J., Souza de Alencar, M., Sanchez Perez Moreno, S., Dykes, K., Bay, C., Zaaijer, M. B., & Bortolotti, P. (2024). IEA Wind TCP Task 55 The IEA Wind 740-10-MW Reference Offshore Wind Plants. IEA Wind TCP
